query:
SELECT 
  branchId,
  productName,
  quantitySold,
  salePrice,
  totalSaleValue
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE branchId IN (20, 300012) AND DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-05'
LIMIT 10;
